sentences.en: The architecture in the city center is neoclassical.
sentences.zh: 市中心的建筑是新古典主义风格的。

sentences.en: The neoclassical painting style was popular during that era.
sentences.zh: 那个时代的画风流行的是新古典主义。

sentences.en: She has a neoclassical approach to interior design.
sentences.zh: 她在室内设计上采用的是新古典主义的方法。
